a_correction_worth_recording.what_happened: the first version reported a within-pair variance fraction of 0.309 for the identity arm. That arm has no cell feature, so the figure was impossible, and a direct one-rep check showed the prediction was constant to 8.7e-21.
a_correction_worth_recording.cause: the aggregation path, not the model
a_correction_worth_recording.fix: plain numpy grouping with an explicit within-pair range, plus a raw max-spread column that cannot hide behind a ratio
a_correction_worth_recording.note: the raw spread is the right statistic here: a ratio can look nonzero from floating-point residue when the true value is exactly constant

why_this_is_structural.reason: neither arm contains a cell-level feature. Identity is a drug indicator and the pathway block is a drug annotation, so with no cell covariate the prediction cannot depend on the cell.
why_this_is_structural.so: the result is forced by the design; its value is in naming the boundary, not in surprise
why_this_is_structural.what_would_lift_it: a cell-level covariate usable when both drugs are unseen, which this resource cannot supply; C90 already showed the tissue block is unreliable under holdout

limits: Only ridge and one resource; two feature sets.
The result follows from the feature design.
Retrospective; no mechanism, clinical or drug-choice claim.

the_answer.question: can the model rank cell lines, or only drug combinations
the_answer.reading: for a fixed drug pair every cell receives the same prediction, to floating-point zero. The rank correlation of 0.1516 is therefore entirely between-combination.

what_a_practitioner_must_know.what_the_model_answers: given two unseen drugs, which combinations are on average more synergistic
what_a_practitioner_must_know.what_it_cannot_answer: which cell line to test that pair in
what_a_practitioner_must_know.why_it_matters: choosing an experiment means choosing cell AND combination; this model orders only one of the two axes

a_second_correction_from_the_same_round.what_I_first_reported: a within-pair variance fraction of 0.309 for the identity arm and 0.0 for the pathway arm
a_second_correction_from_the_same_round.why_impossible: the identity arm has no cell feature, so its within-pair variance must be exactly zero
a_second_correction_from_the_same_round.diagnosis: the ratio was residue over a near-zero denominator. The identity arm's predictions are almost constant, so total variance is tiny and floating-point noise dominates the fraction. The pathway arm happened to show 0.0 only because its numerator was even smaller.
a_second_correction_from_the_same_round.the_fix: report the raw within-pair range, which cannot hide behind a denominator
a_second_correction_from_the_same_round.the_general_rule: when a denominator can approach zero, report the raw quantity alongside the ratio, or the ratio will report noise as signal
a_second_correction_from_the_same_round.count: this is the same family as the zero-width-CI instances: a statistic whose scale collapses and then reads as information
